g.text: Recorded harm in road-tractor casualty collisions, Canada
Includes people in every involved vehicle and pedestrians, 1999–2021; fatal/injury events with recorded vehicle type 08.
Span reflects record handling, not confidence intervals or bounds on true casualties. Unknown severity remains unallocated.
